parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The code does not execute any shell commands; it only constructs and sends HTTP GET requests. Therefore, there is no risk of OS command injection in this context.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding (path contains shell metacharacters) does not apply to this code fragment. The code constructs an HTTP GET request and sends it over a socket. It does not execute any shell commands, so shell metacharacters in the 'path' variable do not pose a risk of OS command injection.
